sources.title: General Intuition: $320M to Train AI on Gameplay, GENZ TECH
sources.snippet: General Intuition raised $320M at a $2.3B valuation, led by Khosla with Jeff Bezos backing, to build a world model trained on gameplay video.

sources.title: General Intuition Raises $320M to Train AI on Gameplay
sources.snippet: General Intuition Raises $320M to Train AI on Gameplay General Intuition raised $320 million at a $2.3 billion valuation on the bet that billions of hours of video game footage - with action labels - can train AI agents that operate in the real world.

sources.snippet: General Intuition, a Dutch AI startup that trains autonomous agents on billions of video game clips, has raised $320 million in new funding at a $2.3 billion valuation. The round, which closed in January but was publicly announced Wednesday, was backed by Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, former Google CEO ...

sources.snippet: General Intuition closes $320M Series B at $2.3B valuation to train AI agents using video game environments, attracting enterprise and defence interest.
